scope: Two separate Android QA installations with synthetic data; personal app data untouched.

runtime.flame: Native tips and embers run continuously at 0.4/0.25, half the original speeds and one-third slower than the previous 2.9 build; exit transitions remain disabled.
runtime.setEditing: Cancel preserves original 40 kg/done; save persists 42.5 kg with done=true and 10 reps.
runtime.nutritionGuide: Independent Monday 2500 and Tuesday 2100 kcal remain distinct when revisiting Monday.
runtime.friendCodes: Default and custom HTTPS QA relays; encrypted lookup and reciprocal confirmation; title plus 3 equipped badges received by friend.
runtime.stretching: Generated quadriceps selection, same-type replacement, saved routine roundtrip, custom exercise with instructions persisted; in-player replacement resets to chosen per-side duration; after-workout action opens editable POST selection. Generated focus groups and muscle chips remain selected when opening the POST editor.
runtime.meditation: Three curated written pauses and player verified with optional ambience and no spoken voice.
runtime.settings: Compact search/sparkles header action opens local settings search; contextual coach action is also in header; large search/coach rows removed.
runtime.notifications: Heart status icon visible for QA workout notification.

weeklyQuests.onboarding: First opening asks Nutrition, Strength, Running and Everyday preferences; saved across restarts.
weeklyQuests.personalization: 14-day diary, workout adherence, perceived-effort feedback, runs, steps and pauses; conservative plateau detection with comparable workout history.
weeklyQuests.primaryAndOptionalSide: Main + different-focus side on one QA installation; nutrition-only main with no side on the other. All four card sizes designed for optional secondary.
weeklyQuests.reward: Main completed from a synthetic 5-minute pause; UI claimed 80 XP; duplicate claim after restart leaves exactly 80 XP and one completed quest.
weeklyQuests.tests: Focus filtering, weakness selection, optional side quests, variety, plateau, missing health data, Sunday feasibility, frozen weekly plan, Monday renewal, persisted once-only claims.
weeklyQuests.widgets: Small, medium, strip and large layouts visually verified on device; primary retained, secondary conditional and compact.

runtime.socialProfile: Settings avatar opens Settings; Profile and social lives inside Settings → Social. Social, badges, progression, leaderboard, invitation and server screens use separated cards; fixed-height milestones replaced by adaptive rows.

liveDefaultServer.health: HTTPS 200, protocol 2, using app HTTP headers
liveDefaultServer.friendCode: Created on default server, looked up by peer, reciprocal confirmation collected
liveDefaultServer.privacy: Synthetic QA data only; endpoint and device identities omitted.

packaging.moduleHashes: All archive sizes and SHA256 match generated index. Meditation archive contains no voice directory.
packaging.privateDefault: Absent from all publishable source files; injected by ignored local config/CI secret.
packaging.standaloneCompose: Compose uses the public GHCR image from server/homeserver; no embedded source or bootstrap code remains.

limits: The user deployed the NAS service; public HTTPS app operations verified. NAS administration and filesystem ACLs not inspected remotely.
